verdicts.note: Three independent sources agree: Senior Deputy Auditor since 2019 [S1][S3], a Colfax councilmember since 2018 who won position 5 in 2023 [S7], the endorsement of the retiring auditor [S1], the slogan 'Trusted Experience. Proven Integrity.' [S1] and the priority of 'preserving institutional knowledge' [S3]. She is the continuity candidate and campaigns on it, so -2 at high confidence holds. The dossier has no contrary evidence.

He comes from outside the auditor's office and has held no elected office [S1]. He calls public service 'a duty, not a career' [S1] and hopes the winner will 'shake things up' and make changes [S5]. Two things keep this at +1 medium rather than +2: he is a county employee with Census and poll-worker experience [S1][S3], and his 'shake things up' line is directed at whoever wins, not presented as his own platform. He also proposes 'investing in the current staff's knowledge and training' [S3], which is continuity-flavored. The score's magnitude and confidence are already modest.
